text: 随着新华保险2025年度末期现金红利正式派发，A股五大上市险企年度分红派息全面收官。中国人保、中国人寿、中国平安、中国太保、新华保险2025年全年累计现金分红总额首次突破千亿元，达到1023.94亿元，创历史新高；较2024年的907.89亿元增加116.05亿元，同比增幅为12.78%。至此，五家上市险企分红频次将从“一年一次”全面迈向“一年两次”。上市险企集中推进中期分红、持续加大分红力度，是看好行业基本面、看好资本市场长期走势的直接体现。五家上市险企一致认为，中国经济长期向好的基本面没有改变，产业升级与科技创新红利正持续释放，为资本市场提供了坚实支
text_en: With New China Life's final cash dividend for 2025 officially distributed, the annual dividend payouts of the five major A-share listed insurers have fully concluded. The total cumulative cash dividends of PICC Group, China Life, Ping An Insurance, China Pacific Insurance, and New China Life for 2025 exceeded 100 billion yuan for the first time, reaching 102.394 billion yuan, a record high; this increased by 11.605 billion yuan from 90.789 billion yuan in 2024, up 12.78% year-on-year. With this, the dividend frequency of the five listed insurers will shift comprehensively from "once a year" to "twice a year." The concentrated push for interim dividends and continued increases in dividend payouts by listed insurers reflect direct confidence in the industry's fundamentals and the long-term trajectory of the capital market. All five listed insurers agree that the fundamentals supporting China's long-term economic growth remain unchanged, and that dividends from industrial upgrading and technological innovation are being continuously released, providing solid support for the capital market.
